NSS Feeds Resource Delete NSS Feed
DELETE
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/nssFeeds/:feedId

Deletes cloud NSS feed configuration based on the specified ID

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
feedId
int32
REQUIRED

Unique identifier for the cloud NSS feed

QUERY PARAMETERS
cloudNss
boolean

A Boolean value indicating whether the feed is cloud NSS feed

Default value: false
Responses
​
default

Successful Operation
